beats.event: Taira no Tadamori wins access to the Imperial court
Kiyomori helps crush the Hōgen and Heiji rebellions
Kiyomori's daughter marries the Emperor; half of Japan is Taira
Kiyomori's arrogance grows: he dismisses Giō, cows the regents
Shishigatani conspiracy plots against Kiyomori at the retired emperor's villa
Kiyomori uncovers the plot and exiles or executes the conspirators
Temple fires and omens are read as signs of Taira decline
Kiyomori dies burning with supernatural fever no water can cool
Munemori takes over; rebellions ignite across the provinces
Minamoto no Yoshinaka smashes Taira forces at Yokotagawara
Munemori flees the capital with Emperor Antoku and the regalia
Yoshinaka briefly and arrogantly rules Kyoto
Yoshitsune routs the Taira at Ichi-no-Tani; Shigehira captured
Minamoto's 3,000 vessels close on the Taira's 1,000
Battle of Dan-no-ura destroys the Taira fleet
Kiyomori's widow drowns holding the child emperor Antoku
Surviving Taira are paraded through the capital
Kenreimon-in takes the tonsure and retires to Jakkō-in
Kenreimon-in dies invoking Amitābha, sole spiritual consolation
